Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Card Q&A.a: It refers to a state where a card has one or more cards such as digivolution cards stacked under it.
Card Q&A.q: What kind of state does "with cards under it" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect refer to?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If [Gesomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 3 cards under 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers without cards under it can't suspend until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand.
